newsitem.title: USA: Community Care names Dean Sloane chairman.
newsitem.headline: Community Care names Dean Sloane chairman.

text.p: Community Care Services Inc said Thursday it named Dean Sloane chairman of the board.
Bruce Ansnes was named to the newly created position of vice chairman, the company said in a press release.
Sloane succeeds Alan Sheinwald who resigned as both chairman and as a director.

The company previously announced that the board terminated the services of Sheinwald as president and chief executive after it was known that Sheinwald, former chief operating officer Allan Goldfeder, and the company were targets of a federal criminal investigation.
The probe involves allegedly improper Medicare payments. Community Care has said it and the officers deny any wrongdoing.
